description: Check an MCP server for real risk signals before trusting it: unauthenticated transport, capability overreach (filesystem/shell/credential access with no scoping), and known-bad signatures. Pass a live server URL, or a manifest of tool definitions if the server isn't reachable over HTTP. Semantic prompt-injection detection runs too if a Pro API key is sent as an Authorization: Bearer header, see /docs.

tools.description: Tool definitions to scan directly, if not probing a live URL

url.description: Live MCP server endpoint (Streamable HTTP transport)

name: scan_mcp_server
title: Scan MCP server
